svg.title: nahuya in Claude Code: four real sessions
svg.desc: Four replays of Claude Code sessions with Opus 5.5. 1, push gate: Claude builds discount codes and pushes; the gate blocks 113 unreviewed lines, nahuya:polish runs a fresh reviewer, it finds nothing to cut, and the push goes through. 2, whole-repo cleanup of a 40k-line Minecraft mod (rebuilt from the session transcript): Claude plans 12 components, asks about tests and the reviewer budget, reviews 7 components, and makes 13 commits, net -190 lines with all 218 game tests green. 3, test cleanup: 98 tests written by Claude without nahuya are pruned to 75, -113 lines, checks green. 4, report-only review of an over-engineered notification module: 3 findings, about -40 lines, nothing changed.

text.tspan: # Group these into logical components for review and write the plan to:
root, server mixins, mcp dev bridge, build
I've mapped the repo: about 39.6k lines of real code in 12 components. The JSON assets that
generates and the guide docs are left out. I have a few questions before I launch the reviewers.
· Should the tests be cleaned up too? That's src/test (1.6k lines, 20 files) and src/gametest
(4.4k lines, one SevenDaysGameTests.kt). They'd get the same treatment: redundant tests and
· The full run needs about 15 reviewers (12 components, a duplicates pass, round 2 and a
possible judge), but max_agents is 10. Estimated cost is ~650k tokens plus verification. How
should I fit it? → Most suspicious first (Recommended)
root, server mixins, mcp dev bridge, build
The baseline check (build, unit tests, game tests) is running. Reviewers for the first two
components are working: the mod root/mixins/MCP bridge, and the client HUD/fx. I'll verify their
Baseline is green: build, unit tests and all 219 game tests pass. I'm waiting on the first two
Both reviewers are back. I'm applying the client findings now, starting with one shared screen kit
in place of four copies, and launching the fortify reviewer in parallel.
(./gradlew build runGameTest > check1.log 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -E '^e:|FAILED|GAME
[14:14:17] [Server thread/INFO] (Minecraft) ========= 219 GAME TESTS COMPLETE IN 44.45 s
8d19037 /sevendays town: the distance from the same distance() that sorts the towns
Five commits in. Launching the guide and perks/crafting reviewers while the fortify one finishes.
4bbbb14 tests tidy: one mob() spawn helper (create, centre, persist, add) in place of ~20
copies and three local ones, one cook(), diamondArmor() and fillWithCobblestone()
Round 2 fixes pass. Logging, committing, and wrapping up.
007da4c round-two tidy: ClientTools imports what it named in full and maps burst's frames
nahuya: review recorded; the push gate's anchor is unchanged
I cleaned up the 7 most suspicious components (21,901 lines, 5,976 of them tests) over 2 review
rounds, in 13 local commits. The build, unit tests and all game tests pass after the last commit.
That's 218 game tests now, one fewer because I deleted a redundant one. Net change is
(489 added, 679 removed across 58 files), about 0.9% of what was reviewed. Nothing is pushed.
